_note: Which model becomes which vehicle in the game. Every one is CC Attribution (credited in Web/cars/CREDITS.md). "carros" names a model in github.com/pedrosoandre/carros (no account needed); "uid" names one on Sketchfab (needs SKETCHFAB_TOKEN). paint names the body-paint material when the library guesses wrong. yaw turns the model so its nose points down +Z if it was authored facing another way; tris is the triangle budget after simplification; livery false drops the game's own roof lamp or light bar (the model has its own).
